messages:
ravi: Idea: add a lightweight export for 'credit provenance' so teams can download why net token numbers changed between billing windows. Minimal columns: route, raw_tokens, credited_tokens_breakdown, net_tokens, rule_version, sample_rate. Thoughts?
emily: Yes please. Finance asked for something they can import into their toolchain. Keep credited_tokens_breakdown as a semicolon-delimited string like 'prefetch:120;chain:30;cache_origin:50'.
quentin: Implementation note: produce a daily CSV from the credit_events table with `rule_version` in the filename. We should also include a `confidence_pct` column computed from sampling.
ravi: Good call. We should also include an opaque `trace_sample_ids` field for high-importance accounts so finance can request audit traces. Make it optional and gated by account flag.
emily: UX: export button should default to last closed billing window and have a checkbox "include raw traces (audit)" that only appears for admins. Also add a small explainer modal: "credits are estimates if sampling<100%".
quentin: SQL snippet to generate CSV rows (batch job):```sql
select route,
       sum(raw_tokens) as raw_tokens,
       string_agg(source||':'||cast(sum(tokens) as text), ';') as credited_tokens_breakdown,
       sum(raw_tokens)-sum(tokens) as net_tokens,
       rule_version,
       avg(1.0/sample_rate) as confidence_pct
from credit_events
where billing_window = '2024-03-01'
group by route, rule_version;
```
ravi: Ops constraints: (1) make export idempotent and include a `file_manifest` table with checksum and rule_version, (2) require a short retention (90d) for exported audit traces to limit exposure.
emily: Billing edge: Dedicated customers must be able to get the export with credits disabled (raw view). Add a flag `export_view=raw|net` to the API.
billing-bot: export job queued for acct ACCT-99 by @ravi for window 2024-03-01. Job id: ex-20240301-009.
quentin: I'll add the CSV schema to infra docs and wire up a signed S3 URL for retrieval. Ravi, can you own the manifest table schema?
ravi: Yep will draft PR today and add sample CSV to the docs.
emily: Thanks all, this should cut down finance back-and-forth.
